caption: A two-panel image where the top panel shows a brown bulldog and a grey cat engaged in a sword fight with sabers, featuring a red and white impact graphic where the blades meet. The bottom panel shows a brown mouse standing and holding its own tail with a wide-eyed, grinning facial expression.

A two-panel illustration. The top panel shows a close-up of a hand hovering near two large red buttons on a grey console. The bottom panel shows a muscular man in a red shirt with brown hair, sweating profusely and wiping his forehead with a white cloth while wearing a distressed expression.

A two-panel image. The top panel shows a green overhead highway sign with a straight arrow and a sharp right-turn arrow. The bottom panel shows a blue car drifting sideways on a highway off-ramp, with white smoke coming from its rear tires as it turns sharply to the right.

A photograph of three people on a city street. A man in a blue plaid shirt is walking with a woman in a light blue top, but he is turning his head completely around to look at a woman in a red dress walking in the opposite direction. The woman in the blue top is looking at the man with a shocked and angry expression.

A comic strip showing a meeting in a boardroom. In the first and second panels, a man in a brown jacket speaks to three employees sitting at a table, all with empty speech bubbles. The third panel shows the man in the brown jacket looking angry, followed by a final frame showing a person being thrown out of a glass window of a tall office building.
